senses.gloss:
m. (दन्तः दन्तौ दन्तः)
2nd case plu. (दतः) A tooth: see दन्त; the nasal is dropped after the 2nd case.
E.
दम to subdue, affix डत्.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Given, presented, made over, assigned.
2 Preserved, guarded, protected.
m. (-त्तः)
1 The name of a king.
2 A saint; also दत्तात्रेय.
3 A common surname or title of a man of the Vaiśya or third tribe, at present common to the Kayeth class.
n. (-त्तं)
A gift, a donation.
E.
दा to give, affix क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Cut, divided.
E.
दा to cut, affix क्त.

m. (-कः)
A son given: see the next.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-त्त्रः)
A son given away by his natural parents, to persons engaging to adopt him; one of the twelve heirs acknowledged by the old Hindu law.
E.
दत्तक, and पुत्त्र a son; also simply दत्तक, and sometimes दत्त्रिम.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Gave, was giving.
E.
दा to give, क्तवतु aff.

f. (-ल्का)
A bride for whom a sum of money has been paid to her father.
E.
दत्त, and शुल्क dower.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Self-given.
m. (-त्मा)
A youth or orphan, who gives himself to persons disposed to take the place of parents.
E.
दत्त given, and आत्मन् self.

m. (-यः)
A sage, the son of ATRI given to him by three deities, BRAHMA, VIṢṆU, and ŚIVA.
E.
दत्त, and अत्रेय son of ATRI; also दत्त.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Given and received.
E.
दत्त, and आदत्त taken.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Treated with respect.
E.
दत्त, and आदर respect.

n. (-र्म्म)
Nonresumption of gifts.
E.
दत्त a gift, अन for अ, neg. before अपकर्म्मन् resuming.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Given and taken again.
E.
दत्त, and अपहृत taken back.

n. (-कं)
Resumption of gifts; one of the eighteen titles of law.
E.
दत्त, and अप्रदानिक not giving.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Attentive.
E.
दत्त, and अवधान attention.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Having a seat given, requested to sit.
E.
दत्त, and आसन a seat.

f. (-त्तिः)
Gift, donation.
E.
दा to give, क्तिन् aff.

f. (-तिः)
Cutting, destroying.
E.
दा to cut, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Given.
2 Produced or effected by gifts.
m. (-मः)
1 A slave who is given by another.
2 A son given by his parents.
E.
दा to give, क्त्रिम aff.

m. (-यः)
The deity INDRA.

ind.
Having given.
E.
दा to give, क्त्वाच् aff.

m. (-त्वः)
A giver, a donor.
E.
दा to give, त्वन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be given, what may or ought to be given.
E.
दा to give, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
A donor, a giver, giving, bestowing.
E.
दा to give, तृच् aff.

m. (-हः)
1 A gallinule.
2 The Cātaka, a sort of cuckoo.
3 A cloud.
E.
दाति destroying, ऊह to plan or arrange, affix अण्; also दात्यौह.

mfn. (-हः-ही-हं)
Of, relating to, or produced in the vehicle of a demon. (E. दैत्य a demon. बह to bear, affix घञ्, अण् added, and the first vowel changed to आ by especial rule.)
m. (-हः)
A gallinule.
E.
see दात्यूह (the radical vowel being optionally changed,) with अण् affix^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-त्रं)
A sort of sickle, a large knife or a Dā.
E.
दो to cut, त्रन् Uṇādi aff.
